label: Present-receipt controls: past-tense and standing receipt under inertia, nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with one world, natural-number times and two individuals, false alone with received esse; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Inertia (true gives false being at time 1 only; false persists from time 1), receipt at time 1 only: the onset reading and correlativity hold; the present-tense reading and 40a97664 fail; received onset is given. (2) Inertia, standing receipt (RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2): the present-tense and onset readings hold; correlativity and 40a97664 fail. (3) Sustaining (true gives false being from time 1 on), no receipt: 40a97664 and correlativity hold; the present-tense and onset readings fail, so 40a97664 does not entail the present-tense reading over the primitive. (4) Inertia with no giving and no receipt: correlativity holds; the onset reading and received onset fail. (5) Inertia with no giving, standing receipt: the onset reading holds; correlativity and received onset fail. (6) Sustaining, standing receipt: the present-tense reading, the onset reading, correlativity and 40a97664 all hold.
